english.title: Fail to deliver dog up to enable order for dog to be taken into possession to be carried out
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having possession of a dog namely, **(..SPECIFY DESCRIPTION OF DOG..) to which an order under section 67 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 applied, failed to comply with a requirement imposed under section 69(1)(b) of that Act to deliver it up to enable the order to be carried out
english.legislation: Contrary to section 69(1) and (2) of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Where a disqualification order under section 66 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 is made where a person is convicted of a specific offence and a dog was used in or was present at the commission of the offence, an order under section 67 of the Act can then be made to order the seizure and disposal of the dog.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, having possession of a dog namely, **(..SPECIFY DESCRIPTION OF DOG..) to which an order under section 67 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 applied, failed to comply with a requirement imposed under section 69(1)(b) of that Act to deliver it up to enable the order to be carried out.
